wiringInterpretation.rationale: Plan_final 04-002 introduces a typed D_DoomMain init orchestrator that runs the canonical 15-step subsystem init sequence (Z_Init, V_Init, M_LoadDefaults, W_Init, I_Init, OPL_Init, NET_Init, M_Init, R_Init, P_Init, S_Init, D_CheckNetGame, HU_Init, ST_Init, I_InitStretchTables) against the shared VanillaRuntimeContext built by 04-001. The order itself is pinned at this step; the individual run() implementations are no-op placeholders that subsequent runtime-core steps will replace with the real subsystem wiring while keeping the order locked. The read-only ref src/bootstrap/initOrder.ts is SHA-pinned and untouched; the new module lives under src/vanilla/ following the 03-001 / 03-003 / 03-004 / 03-005 / 03-006 / 04-001 / 05-001 precedent. A throw from any step is wrapped in VanillaDDoomMainInitError (carrying stepLabel, stepIndex, cause) and aborts the chain — matching vanilla's I_Error-on-init-failure semantics.
publicSurface: VanillaDDoomMainInitStep interface (label, description, run(context: VanillaRuntimeContext): Promise<void> | void)
runDDoomMainInit(context: VanillaRuntimeContext, customOrder?: readonly VanillaDDoomMainInitStep[]): Promise<void>
VanillaDDoomMainInitError extends Error (stepLabel: string, stepIndex: number, cause: unknown)
